description: MUST-NORMALIZE (issue #530, supersedes issue #199's fail-closed rule for this fixture): a pending (unresolved) tracked-change revision occurs INSIDE a field code -- e.g. a cross-reference field whose displayed result is itself under a live counterparty edit. Owner decision 2026-08-09: the revision accepts-all the same way an ordinary pending revision does, with a disclosure note naming what the field resolved to. Issue #99 corrected this fixture's record shape: `original_text`/`resulting_text` carry the WHOLE PARAGRAPH's pre-edit and accept-all text (that is what `extraction_normalization_stage._build_paragraph_record` stamps on every cluster), while the FIELD's own resolved display text is the separate `field_resulting_text` key -- the value the disposition note quotes. This record is copied verbatim from what the real extractor emits for `<w:p>This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of <w:fldSimple w:instr=" REF GoverningLawJurisdiction "><w:del>Delaware</w:del><w:ins>New York</w:ins></w:fldSimple>.</w:p>`. Before #99 this fixture set both to the bare field text, so the paragraph WAS the field and the two values coincided -- which is exactly why the note quoting the wrong one stayed invisible here.

paragraphs.heading: Governing Law
paragraphs.text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Delaware.

revisions.author: counterparty

revisions.resulting_text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of New York.
